The <b>Plasmium Gland</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)#Equipment)|equipment item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. 

== Function ==
The Plasmium Gland acts as an endless reserve of Plasmium when crafting [[Plasmium Phial]]s at [[Bench (Silksong)|benches]]. Before acquiring it, replenishing the Plasmium reserve requires visiting [[Alchemist Zylotol]] and paying him {{R|50}}.

== How to Acquire ==
Obtained as a reward for completing the <i>[[Advanced Alchemy]]</i> [[wish]].
